jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Strategic - East
jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced customer success professional to join Attentive as a Senior Customer Success Manager. You will lead the overall customer strategy for a portfolio of Strategic accounts, shaping program direction, improving performance, and mobilizing the right resources to drive measurable business outcomes and long-term growth across Attentive’s platform.

You will consult and lead on strategy across the customer lifecycle, bringing together Account Management, Services, and technical and product partners to align priorities, clarify ownership, and drive program and account growth. You will translate performance insights into recommendations that strengthen customer value, adoption, and retention while building and growing key client relationships.

This role offers the autonomy and latitude to lead complex accounts, exercise sound judgment, and build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and day-to-day teams. You will represent Attentive in business reviews, onsite and in-person meetings, functions, and strategic customer conversations.

What You’ll Accomplish

- Build and maintain strategic success plans with clear business goals, success measures, priorities, owners, and milestones. Keep customers and internal partners aligned on key initiatives.

- Advise customers on lifecycle marketing strategy across acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention, connecting SMS, email, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive program.

- Coordinate Account Management, Services, and technical and product partners around the customer strategy.

- Develop relationships across executive sponsors, marketing leaders, and technical stakeholders. Lead business reviews and working sessions that connect performance to business priorities and secure decisions and next steps.

- Translate program performance into clear recommendations, testing priorities, and business cases. Assess measurement limitations and evaluate opportunities in the context of customer goals, budgets, and expected returns.

- Maintain accurate revenue and renewal forecasts in partnership with Account Management, using customer usage, performance, and stakeholder signals. Identify risks early, communicate them clearly, and lead coordinated mitigation plans.

- Identify expansion opportunities through customer goals and unmet needs. Partner with Account Management and specialists to build value-based recommendations, define success criteria, and support meaningful adoption.

- Translate customer feedback and integration needs into clear business requirements for product and technical partners. Help customers build the knowledge and practices to sustain success, and share effective approaches with the team.

Your Expertise

- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management, ideally in marketing technology or SaaS, with demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customers.

- Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and growth and retention strategies, with depth in SMS or email and the ability to advise across channels.

- Experience collaborating with commercial, Services, product, and technical teams to translate customer needs into coordinated solutions and measurable outcomes.

- Strong analytical and commercial judgment: you can interpret performance data, ask thoughtful questions about measurement, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.

- Ability to influence stakeholders, navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, and independently drive complex account plans forward.

- Clear, confident communication with executive and operational audiences, strong organization, and consistent follow-through on decisions and commitments.

- Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM, customer success platforms, and reporting tools to maintain reliable account plans, forecasts, and risk visibility.

- Curiosity about emerging marketing technology and AI-powered customer experiences, with the ability to learn new capabilities and assess their relevance to customer goals.

You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

- The US base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 - $150,000 annually + commission + equity + benefits

- Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location

jobs.description:
Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.

Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.

With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

About the Role

Attentive is building the future of marketing with AI. We believe AI will change how brands connect with people and open new possibilities for growth. Our ambition is to help define that future, building on the experience and trust we’ve earned with thousands of brands.

We’re thinking big about what comes next, with the urgency of a startup and the foundation of a well-established business. Joining Attentive is an opportunity to help shape an industry primed for a massive change and have a meaningful role in the company we’re becoming.

What You’ll Accomplish

- Lead annual incentive planning across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and other eligible go-to-market roles. Work with leaders to define performance measures, pay mix, payout curves, accelerators, and plan rules.

- Track, report, and work with Accounting to accrue non GTM bonus plans including executive bonuses.

- Make sure incentives reward the right outcomes. Evaluate how pricing, contract terms, customer commitments, usage, and deal margin affect payouts. Recommend changes that support growth without encouraging poor deal economics.

- Build and test compensation models. Show how different levels of attainment and plan structures affect employee earnings and company costs. Explain the tradeoffs and help leaders reach a decision.

- Own commission operations, including calculation, validation, reconciliation, approvals, and delivery to Payroll. Keep payouts accurate and on time, statements clear, and questions resolved promptly.

- Maintain plan documentation and consistent policies for crediting, ramp periods, guarantees, role changes, adjustments, and exceptions. Work with People, Legal, Accounting, and Payroll on controls and approvals.

- Assess whether plans are working. Track attainment, payout distribution, commission costs, and the behavior each plan encourages. Separate actual results from forecast assumptions and turn findings into recommendations.

- Improve compensation systems and data. Work with Revenue Operations and business systems partners on requirements, testing, and data quality. Use automation and AI where they reduce manual work, improve accuracy and enhance customer experience.

- Lead and develop the compensation team. Set clear responsibilities, review work, and coach people through complex questions. Help managers and employees understand their plans through rollout materials and ongoing communication.

- Partner with FP&A and Accounting on commission forecasts, accruals, reconciliations, and explanations of variance. Prepare clear analysis for senior leadership.

Your Expertise

- 8+ years of relevant experience in incentive compensation, incentive design, or related Finance or Revenue Operations roles, with ownership of both plan design and administration.

- Experience managing and developing a team, ideally including at least two years of people management.

- Experience designing and operating incentive programs in a SaaS, technology, or similarly complex business.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You can build a scenario model, trace a calculation to its source, and spot when an assumption does not hold.

- Practical experience with incentive compensation platforms and Salesforce data. You understand how contract terms, bookings, billing, and payouts connect.

- Sound business judgment. You can challenge a proposal constructively and balance employee motivation, financial discipline, and ease of administration.

- Clear communication with executives, managers, and employees. You can explain a complex plan or a difficult payout decision without losing the audience.

- Care with sensitive information and the discipline to get the details right, even during a busy payout or planning cycle.

- Experience with consumption-based revenue, margin-based incentives, expansion and retention plans

- Direct experience with commission management platforms (Xactly preferred, or equivalent SPM systems like CaptivateIQ, Spiff).

You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

- The US base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000-$270,000 + equity + benefits

- Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location
